completed_task_notes.NEX-039: The first real DecisionProvider adapter, so decisioning stops being a capability the platform can exercise but never use. Product commit 8e670a6, CI 4/4 completed/success at that exact SHA (polled 2026-11-25T19:32Z). Four refusals carry the security argument: a vendor cannot abstain (no 'abstained' outcome on the wire; the caller's threshold decides), the request carries only kind plus sorted candidates (no context hash, no excluded field names, no correlation id), sorting makes order-independence a property of this adapter rather than a hoped-for vendor trait, and a bad answer is an abstention rather than an exception. Construction fails closed on a non-https endpoint or an unbounded name. Two honest limits are recorded in the module docstring: the response size bound is enforced after httpx has read the body, and a rationale is truncated rather than treated as fatal.

run_summary: Implemented NEX-057 on its ADR acceptance path. The `step-up` obligation was the hardest of the five because the other four are predicates over facts the gateway already holds, while step-up asks a judgement - and a model-made judgement is exactly what section 10 forbids. ADR-015 resolves it by replacing the judgement with a deterministic stored fact: the recorded authentication assurance of the delegating human, since every tool handler acts as the delegator and an agent has no assurance of its own. The vocabulary is closed and ordered, derived from IdP acr/amr at login, carried on Principal, copied onto the delegation at grant, compared to a static multi-factor floor, with absent reading as single-factor so an unpersisted value can never become authority. Five alternatives were rejected with reasons, the most tempting being denial-count risk accumulation, which measures behaviour not identity and is steerable in both directions. The gateway still refuses step-up, which is correct: a weaker check under the obligation's name would make the policy read as enforced. NEX-058 records the vocabulary-and-persistence prerequisite. This run also repaired real file corruption: a heredoc append mangled ~4KB of BACKLOG.md, restored via git checkout and redone with the file editor, verified by byte size, marker grep and diffstat. Gates: uvx ruff format --check . -> 292 files formatted (repo-wide, as CI runs it); this caught a python fence in ADR-015 that ruff wanted reformatted - the documented CI trap, fixed before commit. No Python source changed, so check/mypy/pytest were not re-run.

decisions_this_run: D-058: step-up's signal is the delegating human's RECORDED assurance at consent - not a live per-call session read and not a computed risk score. Recorded because a delegation can outlive the session that created it; at consent because that is the moment the human made the choice. Enforcement deferred to NEX-058 rather than half-wired, because a nullable assurance column with no writer silently reads as satisfied once someone forgets to check.
